description:
A transparent single-row concept lineup for Dungeon Matcher: EXACTLY 4 DIFFERENT individual Guild Bulwark characters, one complete full-body sprite centered in each equal-width 64px column from left to right. No typography or ground. Treat the layout diagram as column spacing and equipment silhouette only; independently fully design every character. No duplicates, rotation sheets, consecutive animation frames, touching, detached gear or shared scenery. Full feet on a common ground line, blank gutters. Native three-quarter side view toward screen LEFT. Model crisp small-screen clusters, thin dark contours and upper-left light on the primary rendering style image. Show the face and distinguishing gear. Broad human adventurers matching this cast’s head, limbs, steel and blue Guild cloth. Individual faces and armor. Every single subject must hold a very large shield.
1. a broad salt-and-pepper-haired human captain in a split navy surcoat, braced behind a tall sharply POINTED KITE shield with one steel spine. Visible short iron mace beside rear boot, compact triangular stance.
2. a stocky russet-bearded guild veteran in a woven ochre hood and dark mail, shoulder rolled forward under an enormous ROUND ring-rimmed oaken shield with one raised brass central boss, visible face peering over shield.
3. a tall dark-skinned woman with a short plait and off-white padded high collar, upright behind a shoulder-high square PAVISE with a rectangular sight notch, dark olive rawhide and blue band across middle; broad unbroken silhouette.
4. a compact shaven-headed human with indigo sash, leaning forward under a broad crescent-topped bronze PELTA shield, swept tips rising on both sides, exposed brows and massive strapped forearm, mace behind hip.
disposition: Archived during visual review due to clipped outlines in the lineup. The replacement square compositions supplied the chosen native sprites.

description: 2 BY 2 CHARACTER SELECT GRID. Precisely four complete unique separate fully visible human Guild armored shield tanks with OVERSIZED SHIELDS on transparent background. Use the four thumbnail positions in the supplied square composition reference: top left, top right, bottom left, bottom right. ONE entire figure per quadrant. Keep generous transparent padding around every head, sole and weapon, independent of adjacent cells. Diminutive native RPG battle sprites in west-facing three-quarter view. Main rendering guide is Rattlebones; do not copy his anatomy. No text, grid, terrain or projections. Each body should occupy about 46–52 pixels vertically with 8 pixels or more of clear space from cell edges. In reading order: (1) a broad salt-and-pepper-haired human captain in a split navy surcoat, braced behind a tall sharply POINTED KITE shield with one steel spine. Visible short iron mace beside rear boot, compact triangular stance.
